schema.title: Real-content creditor matrix extraction schema
schema.description: Extract the case header and every creditor row from a Chapter 11 creditor matrix. Rows are a sparse fully-ruled nine-column table; many cells are blank. Return creditors in document (alphabetical) order; use null for any blank cell.

report_title.description: Document title printed centered on each page, e.g. 'Creditor Matrix'.

case_number.description: Bankruptcy case number from the ECF filing stamp, e.g. '23-11132'.

creditors.description: Every creditor row in document order. Use null for blank cells.

address_1.description: First address line (or 'Address Redacted'), else null.

country.description: Country (blank for domestic US rows), else null.

source_page.description: One-indexed PDF page where the row is printed.
